test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

R _ S _ _ _ S G R T _ G _ T S _

options.text: G T R T S G R
R G T R S R G
T G R S T R G
T G R T S R G

solution:
**Given:** R _ S _ _ _ S G R T _ G _ T S _ 

Explanation:

Let's check each option:

1) G T R T S G R → R __**G**__ S __T__ - __R__ __T__ S G - R T __S__ G - __G__ T S __R__ 

2) R G T R S R G → R __R__ S __G__ - __T__ __R__ S G - R T __S__ G - __R__ T S __G__

3) T G R S T R G → R __T__ S __G__ - __R__ __S__ S G - R T __T__ G - __R__ T S __G__

4) T G R T S R G → R __T__ S __G__ - __R__ __T__ S G - R T __S__ G - __R__ T S __G__ 

 
• Here we can see a pattern.
 
• RTSG is repeating itself

Hence, ‘ **T G R T S R G** ’ is the correct answer.
